title: Rotated certificate shows the TLS message, not "cancelled"
goal: After a certificate rotation the companion names the changed certificate and no false service mismatch
acceptance: A committed Swift test fails first, unchanged by the fix: a pinned request rejected after a rotation yields the raw URLError "cancelled" in the status line
The status line shows the certificate-changed message in English and Italian
The service section does not claim a service mismatch before a successful identity check
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-15: find where the raw URLError bypasses NativeConnection.transportError, map it, gate the mismatch line; a test. Not a measurement.
